output_contract.notes: The simulation_results.json will be compared against the paper’s reported values (flat: σ∞≈6.95 eV/Å, C≈-30.70 Å, r_crit≈3.48 Å; buckled: σ∞≈6.61 eV/Å, C≈-33.67 Å, r_crit≈3.31 Å) with appropriate tolerances. The analytical_result.json will be checked by recomputing the deterministic constants from the published formula and comparing within a tight absolute tolerance.
